resources.string: Bluetooth iAP2 handshake → join the car hotspot → start the CarPlay session

When on, phone media and navigation sound plays on the car and the phone itself is muted (the car is silent otherwise).\nSending sound and video together adds load; leave it off if you mainly watch video.\n
Uses native CarWith sound; no extra screen-capture permission needed.
Sound needs screen-capture permission, which will be requested too.
This stops the current attempt and drops both the Bluetooth and Wi-Fi links; tap Connect again to retry.
The bridge needs Xiaomi CarWith and the Xiaomi CarLife component. Check the system car-connection settings first; this does not mean every Android phone can use it.
Wireless pairing with the head unit needs Bluetooth. Turn on Bluetooth and make sure the phone is paired with the head unit.

On Android 12, joining the car hotspot (app-specific Wi-Fi) requires location services; the system uses them to find reachable Wi-Fi and your location is not recorded.\n\nTurn on location services and try again, or join the hotspot manually in Wi-Fi settings.
EasyConn discovery diagnostics need Bluetooth, Wi-Fi Direct and notification permissions
This stops streaming to the car and the keep-alive service; the car display stops immediately.
\n\nNote: the screen-capture permission ends with the service; allow it again next time if you want sound on the car.
Enter this phone\'s real Bluetooth address

Shizuku is not ready, so mcarplay cannot read the phone\'s real Bluetooth address. Receivers such as WinPlay check this address and refuse the connection or send no invitation when they see the system placeholder.\n\nFind Bluetooth address under Settings → My device → All specs, or Status, and enter it; or start Shizuku and reconnect so mcarplay reads it automatically.
Allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\"

When the CarPlay session starts, mcarplay is usually behind the system Wi-Fi settings and has to open CarWith from the background. Without this permission Xiaomi silently blocks it and the car shows no picture.\n\nAllow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\" on the permissions page, then come back and tap Connect again.
